title.zh: 被持有的生命上的 G0

statement.zh: 每个活的主张都被某个立场持有时，G0 恰等于每个立场的 S0 加立场中立（N_std），不需要连通与 N_rel；在连通、每个立场都持有活主张的整体上，S0 加 N_rel 是另一种补全。
statement.en: Where every living claim is held by some standpoint, G0 is exactly S0 at every standpoint with standpoint neutrality (N_std), needing neither connection nor N_rel; on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, S0 with N_rel is another completion.

laws.zh: 在估值上，一个活的主张在某个立场的自身区域中，称为被持有；Held 是每个活的主张都被持有，Unheld 是一个主张无人持有。
laws.en: On a valuation, a living claim is held when it lies in the own region of some standpoint; Held is every living claim being held, and Unheld is a claim no standpoint holds.

laws.zh: 每个活的主张都被持有时，G0（主张层面：每个活的主张从每个立场都有意义）恰等于每个立场的 S0 加立场中立 N_std，既不用连通，也不用 N_rel。
laws.en: Where every living claim is held, G0 at the level of claims (every living claim significant from every standpoint) is exactly S0 at every standpoint with standpoint neutrality N_std, using neither connection nor N_rel.

laws.zh: 持有可判定、每个活的主张都经已形成的关系从一个被持有的活的主张到达时，G0 恰等于每个立场的 S0、N_std 与只指向无人持有者的 N_rel。
laws.en: With holding decided and every living claim reached through formed relations from a held living claim, G0 is exactly S0 at every standpoint, N_std, and N_rel into claims no standpoint holds.

laws.zh: 持有与 S0 不够：每个生命都被持有、只被自己的立场珍视时 S0 处处成立，而 N_std、N_rel 与 G0 都不成立。
laws.en: Holding and S0 do not suffice: with every life held and valued by its own standpoint only, S0 holds everywhere while N_std, N_rel and G0 fail.

laws.zh: 持有与指向无人持有者的 N_rel 都必要：一个无人持有的生命在 S0 与 N_std 之下没有意义；从被持有者到达而无人持有的生命，在 S0 与 N_std 之下没有意义，指向无人持有者的 N_rel 不成立。
laws.en: Holding and N_rel into unheld claims are needed: a life no standpoint holds has no significance under S0 and N_std; a life reached from a held one that no standpoint holds has no significance under S0 and N_std, N_rel into unheld claims failing.

laws.zh: S0 本身已使每个立场的意义沿任何关系进入其自身区域。
laws.en: S0 already carries each standpoint's significance along any relation into its own region.

laws.zh: N_std 不是唯一的补全：在连通、每个立场都持有某个活主张的整体上，处处 S0 加 N_rel 不用 N_std 也给出 G0。
laws.en: N_std is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, S0 at every standpoint with N_rel gives G0 without N_std.

laws.zh: 逐步读、每个形成以自身的事件为自身区域时，每个活的事件都被持有，所以 G0 恰等于每个形成的 S0 加 N_std。
laws.en: Read stepwise with each formation a standpoint whose own region is its own events, every living event is held, so G0 is exactly S0 at every formation with N_std.

hypotheses.zh: 持有：每个活的主张在某个立场的自身区域中；这是对应的前提。把 Ren 提议中的“想要自身延续者”读作持有、把 S0 读作想要，是 AI 提出的读法，依 Ren 的交托采用。
hypotheses.en: Holding: every living claim lies in some standpoint's own region, a correspondence premise. Reading ‘anything that wants its continuation’ as holding and S0 as wanting is the AI's proposed reading, adopted on Ren's delegation.

hypotheses.zh: significant_iff_reached 需要持有可判定，是表示的逻辑承诺，同可判定相等。
hypotheses.en: significant_iff_reached needs holding to be decided, a logical commitment of the representation, as decided equality is.

hypotheses.zh: significant_of_transmits 需要连通，并需要每个立场都持有某个活的主张。
hypotheses.en: significant_of_transmits needs connection and every standpoint holding some living claim.

hypotheses.zh: S0、N_std 与 N_rel 都是假设，不是证明了的前提；本结果说 G0 在被持有的生命上恰等于哪些前提，不证明它们。
hypotheses.en: S0, N_std and N_rel are hypotheses, not proved premises; the result says exactly which premises G0 amounts to on held lives and proves none of them.

hypotheses.zh: G0 已由 Ren 2026-10-11 折叠，不再是公理：在被持有的生命上，这一刻画是第一部分把 G0 作为条件陈述的一种；重述的读法依 Ren 的交托决定。
hypotheses.en: G0 was folded by Ren on 11 October 2026 and is no longer an axiom: on held lives, this characterization is one of the ways Part I states G0 as a condition; the readings of the restatement are decided on Ren's delegation.

does_not_show.zh: 不证明 S0、N_std 或 N_rel，不约束拒绝它们的立场，不推出义务、排序、认识或遵循。
does_not_show.en: Proves none of S0, N_std or N_rel, binds no rejecting standpoint, and infers no duty, ranking, recognition or compliance.

does_not_show.zh: 哪些形成想要，不由本结果给出（“想要”读作 S0，依 Ren 的交托采用）。
does_not_show.en: Which formations want is not given here (wanting is read as S0, adopted on Ren's delegation).

does_not_show.zh: S0 只涉及活的主张，逐步读时它已含“不损”的过滤（Clearing.clearer_not_living），这是规范性的读法。
does_not_show.en: S0 ranges over living claims, so on the stepwise reading it carries the not-harm filter (Clearing.clearer_not_living), a normative reading.

does_not_show.zh: 主张层面的意义分不开把他者算作条件与算作想要者。
does_not_show.en: Claim-level significance does not separate counting another as a condition from counting it as a being that wants.

does_not_show.zh: 无人持有的生命（休眠的种子、昏迷、不再想继续的人）不在本结果的定理之内；按 Ren 的原话它们在公理的范围内，这一意义不决定任何人应当做什么。
does_not_show.en: Lives no standpoint holds (a dormant seed, a coma, someone who no longer wants to go on) are outside this result's theorems; by Ren's words they are within the axiom's range, a significance that decides nothing about what anyone should do.

does_not_show.zh: 只陈述主张层面的 G0。
does_not_show.en: G0 is stated at the level of claims only.

detail.zh: 每个前提都必要：Apart（每个生命都被持有、只被自己的立场珍视，两种中立都不成立：持有与 S0 不够）、Unclaimed（无人持有的生命）、Relayed（被到达而无人持有的生命）。
detail.en: Each premise is needed: Apart (every life held and valued by its own standpoint only, neither neutrality holding: holding and S0 do not suffice), Unclaimed (a life no standpoint holds), Relayed (a reached life no standpoint holds).

detail.zh: N_std 不是唯一的补全：在连通、每个立场都持有活主张的整体上，S0 加 N_rel 给出 G0（Valuation.significant_of_transmits）。
detail.en: N_std is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, S0 with N_rel gives G0 (Valuation.significant_of_transmits).

next_delta.zh: 区分工具性与最终意义的表示；N_std 的哲学根据；整段读法与关系层上的同一形式；与 universal_reason 的接通。
next_delta.en: A representation separating instrumental from final significance; the philosophical ground of N_std; the same form on the whole-run reading and at the level of relations; connecting to universal_reason.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说：“it can be anything that want's its continuation to have significance”，又说：“if we want to add one axiom, that is for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”。AI 把它分为两半，Ren 答“exactly”：动力学定出想要延续者必须计入的范围，定不出中心；那条公理的唯一作用是让每一点都是中心。本结果给出中心一半的形式内容。形式上，“每个想要之点都是中心”落在 S0 上，S0 是每个想要之点上的种子；在被持有的生命上，G0 超出 S0 的可以集中在 N_std 上：从任一中心有意义的，从每个立场都有意义，没有哪个中心特殊。把 S0 读作想要、把 N_std 读作那条公理，是 AI 对提议的读法，依 Ren 的交托采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D11）。N_std 不是唯一的补全：在连通、每个立场都持有活主张的整体上，N_rel 也补全 S0；把关系读作依存时，N_rel 正是“计入自身延续所依存的”的评价形式，所以在依存使每两个生命都相连的整体中，推出的范围加 S0 就到达每个生命。选 N_std 是因为它不需要连通，不是因为它是唯一的补全。与 metaethical-core-characterization 的关系：那里从一个种子出发，需要连通与 N_rel；这里在每个想要的点都有种子，在被持有的生命上只需要 N_std。在连通、有活的主张且每个生命都被持有的整体上，二者都等价于 G0；一般地互不蕴涵，原刻画保持其范围。self-good-reachable-g0 留下了从立场相对的意义到规范意义的桥；AI 的读法把这座桥命名为唯一公理。对手的形状不变：主要的对手接受处处 S0，把意义限在各自的立场之内（Apart，两种中立都不成立），这正是那条公理所否认的边界。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says “it can be anything that want's its continuation to have significance” and “if we want to add one axiom, that is for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”. The AI analysis, which Ren answered “exactly”, splits it in two halves: the dynamics fixes the extent of what a wanting formation must count, not its center; the axiom's one job is to put a center at every point. This result gives the formal content of the center. Formally, a center at every wanting point is S0, the seed at each; on held lives, what G0 adds beyond S0 can be concentrated in N_std: what has significance from any center has it from every standpoint, and no center is privileged. Reading S0 as wanting and N_std as the axiom is the AI's reading of the proposal, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D11). N_std is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, N_rel also completes S0; with the relations read as dependence, N_rel is the valuation form of counting what one's continuation depends on, so in a whole where dependence links every two lives the derived extent with S0 reaches every life. N_std is chosen because it needs no connection, not because it is the only completion. Relation to metaethical-core-characterization: that route starts from one seed and needs connection and N_rel; this one seeds every wanting point and, on held lives, needs only N_std. Where the whole is connected, some claim is living and every life is held, both are equivalent to G0; in general neither implies the other, and the earlier characterization keeps its scope. self-good-reachable-g0 left a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance; the AI's reading names that bridge as the one axiom. The shape of rivals persists: the principal rival accepts S0 everywhere and keeps significance within each standpoint (Apart, where neither neutrality holds), the boundary the axiom denies.

detail.en: Reuses Valuation, SelfGood, transmits, shares, Neutral, Within, Significant, Connected, Reach, reaches and Invariant.reach; the earlier characterization significant_iff keeps its scope.

output.en: The valuation, S0, the two neutralities, connection and G0; invariants along relations.

input.zh: 被持有的生命上 G0 恰等于处处 S0 加 N_std；连通时 S0 加 N_rel 也给出 G0。
input.en: On held lives G0 is exactly S0 everywhere with N_std; on a connected whole S0 with N_rel also gives G0.

conditions.en: Holding; significant_iff_reached also needs decided holding and reach; significant_of_transmits needs connection and every standpoint holding a living claim.

detail.en: Reuses the stepwise valuation Web.valuation (living: active and not undermining; related: co-participation).

output.en: The stepwise valuation of a web.

input.zh: 每个形成以自身事件为自身区域时，每个活的事件都被持有。

detail.zh: 那里留下了从立场相对的意义到规范意义的桥；这里说明在被持有的生命上，G0 超出 S0 的可以集中在 N_std 上。
detail.en: It left a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance; here, on held lives, what G0 adds beyond S0 can be concentrated in N_std.

detail.zh: 在逐步读法上陈述中心沿依存不由动力学推出（Clearing.center_not_derived），复用本结果的 Web.held_by_formations。
detail.en: States on the stepwise reading that along dependence the center is not derived (Clearing.center_not_derived), reusing this result's Web.held_by_formations.

detail.zh: 连通与 N_rel 的读法给出另一种补全，并对无人持有的生命仍有作用。
detail.en: Readings of connection and N_rel give the other completion and keep a role for lives no standpoint holds.

history.en: 14 October 2026, migrated to schema 2 (item F of the open-issues plan: the migration of the 45 schema-1 records with the most lint findings; Ren: “please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session): the claim became 8 laws; the limitations went to does-not-show items, standard boundaries and the hypotheses; the evidence became one paragraph. The three witnesses of “each is needed” became two laws (Apart; Unclaimed and Relayed), each opening with what it shows. “That the extent derived along dependence does not fix the center is shown in derived-extent-limits” is carried by the existing related link. “No ethical axiom and no Lean axiom is used: S0, N_std and N_rel are hypotheses of the theorems” joined the evidence and the hypotheses (hypotheses[3]); the standard boundary no-ethical-premise is not cited, since S0, N_std and N_rel are normative premises. The fold of G0 (a sentence of the limitations and the last sentence of the correspondence, P51) became one hypothesis, without P51; the list of names (Held, Unheld, Apart, Unclaimed, Relayed and others) is carried by the standard boundary names-provisional and the last text_versions entry. The theorem, module and audit counts, the core-purity detail, the review file name with §47.1–47.4 and the periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z of the evidence stay in the receipts, the references and the last text_versions entry. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [held-lives-g0-is-centering.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/held-lives-g0-is-centering.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
